questions.text: Przeczytaj e-mail od Marii do jej przyjaciółki Jen. Oznacz literą T (true) zdania prawdziwe, a literą F (false) zdania fałszywe.

context.text:
To: Jen
From: Maria

Hi Jen!

My new school is great! My English teacher is very friendly. He has got long, curly, black hair and a beard. He's 30 years old. He likes playing the guitar and singing. We all sing in English in class! I love doing English, art and history, but I'm not very sporty. I can't stand PE!

And I live with my mum, brother, stepfather and stepsister. My stepsister looks very different from me. She's got blonde hair and blue eyes and I've got black hair and brown eyes, but we both love dancing and singing. We're very noisy and my brother hates it!

We visit my great-grandmother and great-grandfather at the weekend. They live near our house. They are 90 years old, but they love seeing us!

What's your new school like?

Maria

answers.text: 1. Maria's English teacher isn't very friendly.
4. Maria's stepsister can't stand dancing and singing.
5. Maria lives near her great-grandmother and great-grandfather.
